New Film 'Rays of Belief' Shares Debut Flat on Stock Market

The shares of the film 'Rays of Belief' made a flat debut on the stock market, listing at its initial public offering (IPO) price of ₹239 on both the BSE and NSE. The stock later saw a slight decrease, trading at ₹229 on the BSE. The film's IPO had been heavily subscribed, reportedly by 108 times.
